questions.question_text: If a registration deadline is August 7, 2026, and the late registration deadline is August 11, 2026, how many days after the standard deadline is the late registration deadline?
A student needs to borrow a device from the College Board. If the test date is August 22, 2026, what is the latest date the student can register and request the device to meet the 30-day requirement?
Test center data is updated every three hours. If data was last updated at 9:00 a.m., at what time will the next update occur?
questions.explanation: Adding 3 hours to 9:00 a.m. results in 12:00 p.m.

questions.question_text: If a school decides to schedule a makeup test and moves the date by 14 days from the original date of December 5, what is the new makeup date?
If an exam section has 40 questions and the test taker must spend an equal amount of time on each of the 40 questions over a period of 80 minutes, how many minutes per question is allotted?
A student has 120 minutes to complete two test modules. If the first module takes 55 minutes, how many minutes remain for the second module?
If a test center's data updates every 3 hours starting at 6:00 a.m., how many updates will occur by 3:00 p.m. on the same day?
questions.explanation: Updates at 9:00 a.m., 12:00 p.m., and 3:00 p.m. equals 3 updates.

questions.question_text: A student receives a fee waiver that covers the registration cost of $65 and includes two free score reports. If additional score reports cost $12 each, how much would 5 additional reports cost?
If a test coordinator has 300 students and can place 25 students in each testing room, how many rooms are required?
If the total number of students taking the SAT in a year is approximately 2,000,000 and 15% take the test at an international center, how many students took the test internationally?
Test center data is updated every three hours starting at 6:00 a.m. How many updates will occur by 3:00 p.m. on the same day?
questions.explanation: Updates occur at 6 a.m., 9 a.m., 12 p.m., and 3 p.m., totaling 4 updates.

questions.question_text: If the total number of students taking the SAT in a year is 2,000,000 and 15% take the test internationally, how many students took the test internationally?
A student receives a fee waiver covering $65 for registration. If additional score reports cost $12 each, how much would 5 additional reports cost?
An exam section has 40 questions and the test taker must spend an equal amount of time on each over 80 minutes. How many minutes are allotted per question?
questions.explanation: 80 minutes total / 40 questions = 2 minutes per question.

questions.question_text: If a school moves a makeup test date by 14 days from December 5, what is the new date?
A student needs to borrow a device. If the test date is August 22, 2026, what is the latest date to register to meet the 30-day requirement?
A test center capacity is 200 students. If 85% of the capacity is filled, how many students are taking the test?
A student has 4 hours to complete the test. If they spend 2 hours and 15 minutes on the Reading section, how much time remains for Math?
questions.explanation: 4 hours = 240 minutes. 2 hours 15 minutes = 135 minutes. 240 - 135 = 105 minutes, which is 1 hour 45 minutes.

questions.question_text: If 1 out of every 5 students requests a loaner device, how many loaner devices are needed for 500 students?
A testing fee is $68. If a student pays for the test and 3 extra score reports at $12 each, what is the total cost?
If a room monitor checks 12 students every 15 minutes, how many students can they check in 2 hours?
questions.explanation: 2 hours is 120 minutes. 120 minutes / 15 minutes = 8 intervals. 8 intervals * 12 students = 96 students.

questions.question_text: A test has 98 questions total. If the Math section accounts for 50% of the questions, how many are in the Reading/Writing section?
questions.explanation: If Math is 50%, then Reading/Writing is 50%. 50% of 98 is 49.
